name: gh-inbox
description: Shows GitHub events (comments, reviews, commits, CI failures, merges) for the checked-out branch's pull request and for repositories you register, to read and hand to Claude. Read-only: it never writes to GitHub.

intervalSeconds.title: GitHub: Check interval (seconds)
intervalSeconds.description: How often the pull request of the checked-out branch is checked. Values under 30 are raised to 30.

channel.title: GitHub: Where notices show
channel.description: toast: a toast over the transcript. log: a dim line in the transcript. notify: a desktop notification through your notification channel.

maxRepos.title: GitHub: Repositories checked
maxRepos.description: How many repositories /inbox repo add can register. Each one is asked about once per check (an unchanged one costs nothing); keep it small enough that the checks fit GitHub's rate limit.

language.title: GitHub: Language
language.description: The language of notices, commands and panes, and of what is handed to Claude with a prompt. en: English. ja: Japanese.

tray.title: GitHub: Tray
tray.description: Keep a line under the prompt telling how long ago each registered repository's last event happened.

notifySelf.title: GitHub: Notify my own activity
notifySelf.description: Also notify comments, reviews, commits and closes made by the account gh is logged in as.
